item.title: Morning bundle - 6 November 2026
item.description: Correction added 7 November 2026: the original audio labels preliminary November 5 closing prints as settled closes. Correct settled figures include MRVL 133.55 dollars (-16.43%), MU 656.39 dollars (-17.46%), CRDO 112.33 dollars (-17.71%), AAOI 46.89 dollars (-20.89%) and NVDA 181.60 dollars (-9.26%). All prices are US dollars. Other exact AI-infrastructure closing figures in the audio were also preliminary. The selloff conclusion is unchanged. The original audio is retained; use settled historical closes rather than its exact closing figures. Full morning bundle without email or account details. Weather, Daily Stoic, Binance update number eight plus the sixth Japan announcement, crypto and proxy brief with intraday equities, JV crypto baskets (latest available November 4 snapshot, predating Thursday's selloff), AI infrastructure brief using preliminary November 5 closing prints (corrected above) with Applied Optoelectronics post-close results, the AI and crypto trend check with the social scorecard, 22V research previews and transcript notes, and your standing reminders. All prices US dollars. Original quote timestamps and reporting caveats retained. Not live quotes or trade instructions.
